en: Well then... I'm good to go, right?
Thank you so much, Kiryu-san.
I'm very grateful. Thanks a lot!
Quite the trouble I've caused.
Were you... watching this whole time?

Yeah, I heard everything. It seems like
they've both strengthened their resolve.

Did you know the whole time?
Were you testing those two?
What would you have done if I hadn't stopped you?
I wonder... But I assumed that you would.

Sometimes you can tell what a person is
thinking just by the look in their eyes.
Clever guy.

I will continue to test them.
If you would like to interfere, please feel free.

Nah... I'm sure they'll be fine,
especially with you on their side.

Well, thank you. She's a handful...
I guess new responsibilities are part of getting older.
Yeah... I know what you mean.

Excuse me...!
You're Kiryu-san, right?
You're... the guy from the Setouchi Warriors?

Yeah, I'm from the Warriors. Name's Chiba.
Thanks fer your help the other day.

Nah, if anything,
I wanted to apologize for the mess I caused.
So... What can I do for you?
Actually... Can you help us again?
Again?

Yes, some guys dropped out of the team,
and now we can't even play regular games.

Until now, our key player, Ino-san, had been
recruitin' new players fer us when we'd get low...

But he seems really preoccupied lately,
so he hasn't kept up with the team...

I've been trying t'scout in his place...
But you're the only person I could think of...

I see... So a few other guys quit the team?
What happened?

I don't know how to put this, but... I think
your big fight the other day was a factor.

Some'a our best guys defected to other
teams. Call it frustration, call it fear...
That's on me I guess...

Well, Nagumo-san n' his friends got
banned for life, so there's a bright side?

So... whaddaya say?
Do y'think you can help me out?

I've got a lot going on right now,
so I was actually going to say no, but...

Since I'm at least partially responsible for
the lack of manpower... I guess... I'll help out.

Thank you so much!
I'll be waiting fer you at the baseball field!
All right. See you there.

Kiryu-san! I've been waiting fer ya!
Y'came to help, right?

Everyone! Kiryu-san came to help out!
We'll be able to play again!
I thought it was good as canceled...

C'mon now guys, show some team spirit!
Sorry 'bout this, Kiryu-san.

Hey, let's play ball already,
ya buncha wimps.

That's Hamana, captain of the Thunders. He quit
'cause of a job transfer, but now he's back.

He played high school baseball in the nationals!
He's really good, but he's kind of an ass!
S-Sorry! We have nine guys now!

Hmm... we'll have you play right field,
Kiryu-san! Can y'get changed real quick?

Okay, everybody ready to do this!?
Let's go! We are Setouchiii!
Warriors!
W-We lost...
Yeah, we got wrecked.

C'mon guys, gimme a break...
You losers call this a team? Geez...
I-I'm sorry.

This's amateur hour over here.
I prefer games that don't bore me...

Ya know what? I won't waste my time
again until y'can beat our farm team.
Shall we head home?
Your reputation isn't so hot, huh?

Our best players up n' quit, so now
we're basically the worst team in Onomichi.

We got no strong players, no real manager,
and no connections to get fresh blood in.

At this rate, we'll probably end up
having t'disband the team...

Hmm... Maybe you guys just need to
find a captain with more charisma?
A captain with charisma...

Ummm... Kiryu-san!
Can't you be our team captain!?

Yes, you're totally charismatic enough to
lead us and find some new teammates!

Not t'mention... If what I saw on the field
wasn't no fluke, you're a natural!

I've hit some balls before... But that's a
time commitment I just don't have...

Yeah, but... Y'know we're only in this
situation 'cause of that ruckus...

Yeah, you got me there...
Fine, I'll be your team captain.

Yeeeaaah!
Thank you so much, Captain Kiryu!

I don't know the first thing about this,
though. You'll walk me through it, right?

Fer sure! I'll explain everything!
Come on down to the field whenever!

The field's only open in the day, though,
so don't bother coming if it's dark out!

Well then, I look forward t'working with ya,
Captain Kiryu!
Heh, this should be interesting...
Hmm... Not good...
Yer darn right...
We've been waiting fer ya, Captain!

(Oh yeah... One thing lead to another and
now I'm a baseball team captain.)

Yo. What's the issue here?
You guys sounded kind of down.

We wanted t'get some practice in,
but we don't even have enough guys...

So we were trying t'figure out a way
to practice with so few players!

I-I see... I guess it's going to be problematic
until we get some new players here, huh?

Right on the nose... But if we don't
practice, my dream of goin' pro is...
Really? You're trying to go pro?

But yeah, I know all about how tough it is.
I couldn't even make the minors...

This is the only team a terrible player
like me gots any right t'be on...

But, if you're going to dream...
Might as well dream big, y'know?

Heh, that's the truth.
I didn't know baseball was your thing.
Oh no no, it's nothing too big...

But back t'reality here, it sucks that we
can't practice because we're short...

You're right...
How many guys we do have now?

Nine, including you...
It'd be nice t'have 'least one more guy.

We can't even substitute any players
with a roster like this...

Hmm... Sounds like the first thing we
have to do then is recruit new guys.
But where would I even begin to look...

You guys wouldn't happen to know
anyone who'd be interested?
Umm... Well, maybe there's one...
Oh? And who'd that be?
Well... He's uh...
Chiba-san, you talkin' 'bout Moritsuka-san?
Moritsuka?

Yeah, he was on Chiba-san's high school team.
They were swinging fer the nationals together.

I heard he even caught a pro ball scout's eye,
but he dropped out after some trouble.
Huh. Is that so?
W-Well, yeah...

Moritsuka-san's a pitcher,
so it'd be real helpful if he joined.

I'm the only pitcher we've got now,
and I don't got the endurance t'last...

Sounds like a second pitcher would be good then.
Where's this Moritsuka guy at, Chiba?

Well, if I had to bet, I'd guess he's at a liquor
store, gettin' into pointless arguments?

A liquor store...
Guess I'll have to check it out.

But... I doubt it'll do much good to
just walk up and have a chat.
He's not... quite what he used t'be.

Chiba...
What happened between you?
Uh, nothing...
It's up to you now, Captain Kiryu!

(Whatever. I guess I'll see if I spot
him at any of the local bars...)

Moritsuka's probably at a liquor store,
drinking or arguing about stuff...

Although... I don't expect jus' talking
t'have any real effect on him...
Hm? A fight?
Piece o' shit Moritsuka!

Fer a guy who wanted to go pro,
you're pathetic.

Moritsuka? Isn't that the baseball player
Chiba mentioned?

If y'don't stop picking fights like
this, yer gonna end up dead!

You used t'be the talk o' the town...
Now look at ya. You're a loser, Moritsuka.
We'll be back fer some more later!
Damn... assholes...

He's in terrible shape...
Guess I'll give this a try.
Are you Moritsuka?
Huh...? Who the hell're you?

My name's Kiryu...
There's a matter I want to discuss with you.

Discuss? With me?
Hey, you right in the head?

So, what is it y'wanna talk about?
This ol' drunk's ears're wide open.

Thing is... I'm the captain of a baseball team
called the Setouchi Warriors.

I won't mince words.
We need you on the team.
Hell naw.

Why?
You used to play, didn't you?

I don't play baseball anymore...
I hate the game now.

I've heard you had some sort of trouble...
What happened?
Heh... Like I'd tell you any o' that.
Booze... Gimme some damn booze.

You're pretty drunk already.
I suggest you stop.
Shaddup! What's yer problem, man?

I'm pissed off as it is. Lemme hit the
bottle... Or I'm gonna hit you!
You're a bulldozer...

Thought I had ya... Especially one-on-one...
Always someone stronger though, eh?

You're drunk, but you can still throw a punch.
I'd say you're still quite an athlete.

Maybe so, but that don't
mean I can still play ball...

What happened?
You used to love it, didn't you?

Love's an understatement.
Baseball was my entire world...

I see... I'd heard some kind of
scandal disbanded the team...

Yeah, but I didn't give up on goin' pro.
Even made the minors after high school.

I was determined... My team was weak,
but I practiced hard every damn day.

Never got the team a win, but a
scout noticed I had some hustle.

Even told me I'd make the draft if I kept
postin' up the results I was showing.
Whoa... You were pretty good.

But then... Some asshole on the team
goes down on an assault charge.

Apparently he got drunk and punched
a dude out in some downtime...
The entire team took the fall fer it...

Our team was barely scrapin' by to begin
with, so of course we ended up disbanding...
I'm sorry to hear that...

Toppin' it all off, the guy who started the
fight was a punk who never liked the game.

My life went down the shitter...
All 'cause of that asshole...

I've just been drinkin' my sorrows away
since then, trying t'forget baseball...

But in the end... I love that damn game.
I'll never get it outta my head...

So please, gimme some booze?
Can't y'see what a mess I am?

Moritsuka...
What about giving baseball another chance?
Too late fer that now...
Moritsuka!

Oh, Chiba? Been a while.
Y'here to laugh at me?

Ya never could hit one of my pitches...
But lucky you, now y'can get your hits in...
Enough... Enough o' this...
What'd y'say...?

I was always a step behind you...
Moritsuka, the school's ace pitcher...

I played every day in hopes of hitting one of
your pitches... In hopes of being like you...

I envied you... You had the raw talent and
physique for baseball, and I had neither...

And yet... You gave up on the sport
just because your team disbanded!?

Aren't there other paths to going pro?
Why'd y'give up so easily!?

I'm not the only one. How many other
players admired you enough to try harder!?

But then you go and quit over somethin' so lame,
and drink the day away... What's your problem!?

You had the talent and the passion,
but y'gave up on baseball...

As a guy with no talent but the will to keep
goin', I can't forgive that!
Moritsuka... Let's play ball again.

That dream's somewhere down there, right?
Drinkin' isn't gonna make it come true.

Let's chase the dream together again.
Jus' like the old days.

Go back to being the cool Moritsuka...
The guy I admired so much...

Whoa, whoa...
That wasn't like me at all.

Nah... It's definitely like you.
Y'were always the passionate one.

Did y'know...
I always admired that?
Kiryu-san... I take back what I said.

Sign me up...
I wanna be on a team with you n' Chiba.

Yeah, my classmate put his heart on the table...
I gotta meet him halfway, right?

I haven't worked toward the life I wanted,
and if I don't start, I'll just die with regrets.

So, it's time to aim for goin' pro again.
But it all starts with hittin' the field.

Going pro?
You sure you can tough it out?

Yup. If you're gonna dream,
ya might as well dream big.

Besides... I just really wanna play baseball.
Don't make me say this stupid shit.

Heh... Nice.
See you on the field, Moritsuka.
Nice t'be back... Chiba.
Yeah...!
There, now we have ten players.

Our team's gonna be so much better
now that Moritsuka joined.

But I've heard people all over Onomichi
have some experience with baseball.

If y'could find even a few of 'em,
that would make us even better!
You got it.
Well, well, if it ain't the Setouchi weaklings.

Oh, you bulkin' the team up?
Moritsuka, you're joining these clowns?

A guy with your talent?
It's wasted on this team.

Ain't yer business.
Y'haven't changed a bit, Hamana.

More importantly... Our team's bigger now!
It's time to play a game!
You'll play us if we beat your farm team, right?

Sure. Where you're at now,
no point even gettin' dressed.

My boys on the farm team are gettin' bored,
so maybe this'll be the spark they need.

They may be a farm team, but when you see
the lightning, the Thunder's comin'.
Hmph... Bring it on.

Tell your farm team to bring their best.
...The Warriors are coming.

Heh... Bold talk.
Captain Kiryu, was it?

A line like that... Hope y'don't
end up eatin' them words.

The Thunder's gonna boom...
So hide while y'can.
See ya'll losers on the field.

That piece o' shit...
He ain't changed.
Yup... So we gotta win here!

Yeah... But that means we're gonna
need t'keep getting bigger.
